title: Company card audit checklist
excerpt: A short checklist to identify why a business listing is missing views, calls, and bookings.
seoDescription: Applied checklist for checking the local business card: categories, services, photos, reviews, prices and customer actions.
inside: minimum improvement plan for the week

body.title: How to Use
body.body: Open the business card and go through the items in order. If there is no clear answer to the question, this is an area for improvement.

body.title: Quick checks
items: is the basic service clear in the first 10 seconds
are there prices for key services
are fresh photos of the result visible
are there any responses to recent reviews

title: Review Reply Templates
excerpt: A set of baseline scenarios for responding to positive, neutral, and challenging feedback without bureaucracy.
seoDescription: Ready-made structures for responding to reviews for local business: thanks, clarification, re-recording and working with objections.
inside: reply to a short review without text

body.title: The main rule
body.body: The template should be a foundation, not a copy-paste. Add one specific detail from the review to make the response look alive.

body.title: Base structure
items: mention a specific service or situation

title: Local Marketing Control Table
excerpt: Simple control structure: card, reviews, news, partnerships and repeat touches.
seoDescription: Table template for regular monitoring of local marketing: maps, reviews, news, partnerships and results.

body.title: Why you need a table
body.body: It helps to remember regular activities. Local marketing rarely breaks in one day, but sags quickly if nothing is updated for a month.

body.title: What to track
items: number of new reviews and responses
